metadata.prompt:
[Intro]
[Light piano pickup, brushed drums, ceramic click]

[Verse 1 - Young Female]
叮一声，杯沿碰到晴天
你抬头，刚好接上这一拍
窗边的光，偷偷走过来
把你的影子，也拉起来

[Verse 2 - Young Male]
笔尖停在，你笑起来之前
这一页，怎么也画不完
如果今天，只记住一段
就记住，你等我的半拍

[Chorus - Female and Male Duet]
往左半步，借一点光
往右半步，心事先放一旁
慢半拍，也没关系
我等你，把这一句唱完

[Outro - Gentle Duet]
叮一声，落在午后窗前
这一拍，我们都在里面
[Short instrumental button ending]
metadata.tags: Original Mandarin cafe musical duet, youthful bright female lead and gentle youthful male answering voice, warm Japanese small-town afternoon, intimate natural storytelling, light piano, acoustic guitar, upright bass and soft brushed drums, subtle ceramic click rhythm, 104 BPM, 4/4, gently swinging but not slapstick, memorable lyrical melody with room for easy side steps, clear Mandarin diction, short question and answer phrases, female first verse, male second verse, two voices in the chorus. A compact approximately 50-second complete musical number with a 2-second pickup and a clean musical button ending; no long instrumental intro, no wordless filler, no rap, no belting, no crowd applause, no electronic dance drop, no heavy orchestral comedy stings. Keep the singers emotionally close and playful rather than theatrical caricatures.
